Spacecraft name TRISAT (NANOsky, Misija Trisat)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Mass in kg 3.758 kg
Status Reentry 2024-09-29. Was operational (Official website and reports with data on SatNOGS as of 2020-09-24)
Launched 2020-09-03
NORAD ID 46280
Deployer QuadPack (XL) [ISISpace]
Launcher Vega (Small Satellite Mission Service)
Organization University of Maribor
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Country Slovenia
Manufacturer AIVT by SkyLabs
Partners SkyLabs
Oneliner

Demonstrate CubeSat platform technologies and multispectral infrared imager payload.
Description

The primary mission objective is to perform IOD of the satellite platform with focus on:–evaluating the suitability of the power, communication, on-board data handling and imaging hardware systems for use in a space environment. Additional objectives include:–acquisition of payload data from the satellite for research purposes–providing a satellite platform for educational purposes for students at the University of Maribor. Main payload is multispectral SWIR imager (SkyLabs). Based on a highly miniaturized nanoscale platform from Slovenian Company SkyLabs
